description: Sales/order data for the Talk-to-my-data PoC, stored as managed Delta tables in Azure Databricks under catalog tgs_talk_to_my_data, schema tgs_talk_to_data. customer_state is used as the location dimension (proxy for TGS's store/country dimension) since the source dataset is a single-country online marketplace.

tables.name: orders
tables.description: One row per order. Anchor table for the whole schema. 99,441 rows.

columns.order_purchase_timestamp: when the order was placed - use this for time-based aggregations
columns.order_delivered_customer_date: when the customer received the order

tables.name: customers
tables.description: One row per customer, with location. 99,441 rows.

columns.customer_id: unique per order (note: same real person may have multiple customer_id values)
columns.customer_unique_id: stable identifier for the same real person across orders
columns.customer_state: 2-letter Brazilian state code - use this for 'by country/region/store' style questions

tables.name: order_items
tables.description: One row per line item within an order. This is where price and quantity live - use this table for any revenue or units-sold calculation. 112,650 rows.

columns.price: item price in BRL - use SUM(price) for revenue
columns.freight_value: shipping cost - NOT part of revenue

columns.product_category_name: category name in Portuguese - join to category_translation for English

tables.name: category_translation
tables.description: Lookup table translating Portuguese category names to English. 71 rows.

tables.name: order_payments
tables.description: Payment method and installment info. A single order can have multiple rows (installments) - do not use this table for revenue, use order_items.price instead. 103,886 rows.

columns.payment_value: amount for this payment installment - sums to order total, not per-item revenue

tables.name: order_reviews
tables.description: Customer satisfaction score per order. 104,162 rows.

tables.name: geolocation
tables.description: Zip-prefix to lat/lng lookup. 1,000,163 rows. Rarely needed for KPI questions - only join if the user explicitly asks about mapping/distance.

business_terms.revenue: SUM(order_items.price), NOT payment_value, and excludes freight_value
business_terms.sales: ambiguous - always clarify with the user whether they mean revenue (BRL) or units sold (COUNT) before running the query, same pattern as the client's own demo video
business_terms.top performing products: ranked by SUM(order_items.price) by default; offer units-sold as an alternate ranking
business_terms.cancelled/invalid orders: exclude order_status IN ('canceled', 'unavailable') from all revenue and product KPIs
